我们发现了高度进化的动物生命！在正确科技的引领下，我们或许可以最终进行提升这些生命体的智慧和智力——或者说，是有机体中被认为是智力的东西。

哦。

基因表达学机制技术应该符合要求，我们是时候将这些生物提升到一个全新的境界了。
texts.en:
We have discovered highly-evolved animal life! With the right Technology, we may eventually be able to Uplift these beings to sapience and intelligence - or what passes for intelligence among organics.

Oh.

The Epigenetic Triggers technology should fit the bill, and we are in fact ready to elevate these creatures into a brave new world of existential angst.

texts.zh:
我们发现了高度进化的生命体！在正确科技的引领下，搞不好还可以进行提升，提升他们的自我知觉和智力——或者说，是有机体中被认为是智力的东西。

时刻注意我们的研究才是明智之选。如果有机会的话，我们可以将这个种群向外源性刺激推进。
texts.en:
We have discovered highly-evolved animal life! With the right Technology, we may eventually be able to Uplift these beings to sapience and intelligence - or what passes for intelligence among organics.

It would perhaps be wise to keep an eye on our research, and direct it towards Epigenetic Triggers if given the opportunity.
